title: bortle9.space traffic
description: Visitors of the astro gallery: origin access log (pages, downloads, countries, referrers; LAN excluded) and Cloudflare edge totals (incl. cached images).

SELECT count("bytes") AS "requests" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "agent"
SELECT count("bytes") AS "views" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND ("status" = '200' OR "status" = '304') AND "kind" = 'page' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "page"

panels.title: Where visitors came from (external referrers, newest first)

targets.query: SELECT "referer", "page", "country" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND ("status" = '200' OR "status" = '304') AND ("kind" = 'page' OR "kind" = 'index') AND "referer" <> '' AND "referer" !~ /bortle9\.space/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT count("bytes") FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1h), "status" fill(0)

panels.title: User agents hitting the origin most

targets.query: SELECT "ua", "uri", "status", "country" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Probes: most requested missing or blocked paths (404/403)

targets.query: SELECT "uri", "status" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND ("status" = '404' OR "status" = '403' OR "status" = '400' OR "status" = '405') AND "uri" !~ /^\/(favicon\.(ico|png)|apple-touch-icon.*\.png)$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT count("bytes") AS "probes" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND ("status" = '404' OR "status" = '403' OR "status" = '400' OR "status" = '405') AND "uri" !~ /^\/(favicon\.(ico|png)|apple-touch-icon.*\.png)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "asn"

SELECT "uri", "status", "country", "asn", "agent" FROM "access" WHERE "lan" = '0' AND ("status" = '404' OR "status" = '403' OR "status" = '400' OR "status" = '405') AND "uri" !~ /^\/(favicon\.(ico|png)|apple-touch-icon.*\.png)$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT sum("uniques") FROM "cf_hourly" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT sum("bytes") FROM "cf_hourly" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT sum("threats") FROM "cf_hourly" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT sum("requests") FROM "cf_hourly" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)
SELECT sum("cached_requests") FROM "cf_hourly" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

options.content:
**Origin** panels come from nginx on boris: every request that reached the server, minus the home network (`lan = 1`). HTML is never cached by Cloudflare, so page views here are complete. Image requests are mostly answered by Cloudflare's cache and show up only in the **edge** panels.

No visitor addresses are stored; country, state/region and city come from Cloudflare's location headers (logged from 2026-10-27 on; earlier views have country only). The Country picker at the top filters the state and city tables. The network is the visitor's AS number (added by a Cloudflare transform rule, logged from 2026-10-27 on); common ones are named, the rest show as a number you can look up. Source is the referring site; device is bot, mobile or desktop, guessed from the browser's user agent (bots that pretend to be browsers count as desktop). `page` is only set when a page or full-res file was actually served (200, or 304 when a returning visitor's browser revalidates a page), so scanners probing for `/wp-login.php` end up in the status chart, not in the target table.

Edge numbers are Cloudflare's hourly zone totals (the free plan has no finer data), refreshed every 15 minutes by `cfstats.py`; the current hour fills in as it goes. Unique visitors are counted per hour by Cloudflare, so summing hours counts a visitor once per hour they were active. Compare with Analytics → Traffic in the Cloudflare dashboard once; they should agree.

panels.title: Blocked or challenged at Cloudflare, by reason

targets.query: SELECT count("path") AS "requests" FROM "cf_security" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "source", "action"

panels.title: Recent Cloudflare blocks (these never reach boris)

targets.query: SELECT "source", "action", "rule", "path", "country", "asn", "ua" FROM "cf_security" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
